professionalSummary: Experienced Customer Success Specialist with a proven track record of onboarding distribution‑centre sites, conducting quarterly health checks, driving adoption of automated slot allocation, coordinating escalations, and documenting hand‑over conditions.
experienceHighlights: Onboarded fourteen distribution‑centre sites across four customers, tracking milestones such as dock configuration, shift templates, and first automated week.
Ran quarterly health checks with nine assigned customers, recording agreed actions in account notes.
Achieved automated slot allocation at 21 of 32 assigned sites by end of Q2, up from 12 of 32 at end of Q4 previous year, meeting the team’s quarterly baseline of 12 sites.
Coordinated escalations with support and product via the escalation board, with fixes and roadmap commitments decided by the product manager.
Authored quarter‑end account notes detailing open limitations and hand‑over points for each customer.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Adoption dashboard export showing automated allocation per quarter and baseline line, accompanied by a quarter‑end account note as verification trail.
